subject: Vendor onboarding paperwork & payment path options
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emma Howard <emma.howard@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding paperwork & payment path options

Hi Emma — great to meet today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so procurement can finish vendor setup on your side.

Summary from our call:
- You team is evaluating Redwood for inference serving across two pilots (security-sensitive metrics and personalization).
- Procurement wants a short vendor packet, tax form (W-9 or W-8), and bank instructions.
- Primary question: will Nimbus prefer invoice/PO flow or pay-by-card/marketplace?

What I’m attaching: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (high-level company info, SOC2 link, sample SLA) and Redwood_W9_Template.pdf. These are the docs our finance team needs to create the vendor record.

Quick asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm preferred payment path (PO + invoice vs corporate card / marketplace)? If PO, does procurement require net30, net45, or a different term?
2) If you prefer PO flow, please loop in procurement (procurement@nimbus-analytics.com) and request the vendor setup contact to complete the attached packet. If you prefer card/marketplace, let us know so we can skip bank routing.
3) If you need any certs or legal contact to speed things, I can introduce our finance lead.

Target: if we get preference and completed packet by next Tuesday (10/26), we can lock start-of-test on 11/02.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Ben and Marissa internally to coordinate any additional asks.

—
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://www.redwood.com
From: Emma Howard <emma.howard@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding paperwork & payment path options

Aditya — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. We prefer PO + invoice for anything over $5k, and net30 is standard for Nimbus. I’ve forwarded your packet to procurement (procurement@nimbus-analytics.com) and asked them to complete the vendor packet.

Procurement note for your team: they will need the W-9 filled out and a copy of our contracted SLA. I expect they’ll respond with a vendor setup checklist and a routing contact (typically AP onboarding).

I’ll keep you posted — if procurement asks for anything else I’ll escalate to you.

Best,
Emma
Director, Product Operations
Nimbus Analytics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 07:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding paperwork & payment path options — finance heads-up

Looping finance playbook items so we don’t get blocked:
- If Nimbus requires a signed W-9, we should confirm whether legal wants a signature on the onboarding packet or if an emailed PDF is sufficient.
- If they are net30, we should confirm invoice cadence and whether they require electronic PO matching (some large customers require a PO number on invoices).
- Marissa — can you prepare a concise cover email for AP with the fields AP will need in the vendor portal (legal name, EIN, bank wiring instructions, remittance email)? I’ll draft the suggested invoice template for the Nimbus PO matching.

Also adding a short attachment list we can provide on first pass: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf, Redwood_W9_Template.pdf, SOC2_Link.txt (drive link), Sample_SLA.pdf

Thanks — try to get the cover email ready today so Aditya can send to procurement when they respond.

—Ben
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: procurement@nimbus-analytics.com, Emma Howard <emma.howard@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding paperwork & payment path options

Hi procurement team — following up with the packet (attached) and a short checklist to make vendor setup painless.

Checklist for AP onboarding (attached):
- Completed W-9 (signed PDF) — required for US vendors
- Vendor legal name, EIN/Tax ID
- Bank wiring instruction PDF (if you will pay via ACH/wire) OR confirmation that Nimbus will use corporate card/marketplace
- Remittance email and PO preferences (do you require a PO number on the invoice?)
- Preferred invoice format (PDF, single-page summary + line items)

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf, Redwood_W9_Template.pdf
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cOnboardingPackets

If you can confirm PO requirement and upload the completed packet to the Drive link, we’ll push the first invoice template and finalize start date. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps — propose 10/25 or 10/26.

Thanks,
